cipher.summary: Fixed the NaN-retryAfterMs edge case, bounded the in-memory rate-limit Map with an opportunistic prune sweep, and guarded every route's `getClientAddress()` call behind a safe fallback, all in response to independent Gemini Code Assist and Copilot review findings on PR #222.
cipher.risks: None new; this closes gaps in the mitigation added earlier the same day without changing its documented in-memory/per-instance limitation.
